confirmation.rule: When the first-pass deck completeness is within [trigger_min_percent, trigger_max_percent], run extra_passes more independent checker passes and take, per question, the median value of all passes. A null bound is disabled.

proof.rule: A question marked requires_proof cannot be 'found' from the deck alone. The checker must cite at least one claim whose status is proven (annex) or confirmed (web); otherwise the code caps the value at 'partial'. A question citing a claim left as 'to_probe' after review is lowered by one step.

annex_gate.rule: No annex: stop, generic email. Annexes present: the key claim types the deck makes (revenue, customers, retention) must be covered by at least one proven claim in a proportion of min_key_coverage; below that, stop and email the precise list. At or above it, continue and list what is still missing in the report.

gaps.rule: A gap between a deck figure and the figure found in an annex or on the web is classified by code. Ratio = |deck - found| / max(|found|, 1). minor: ratio <= minor_max_ratio, noted, no penalty. to_probe: ratio <= probe_max_ratio, becomes a question for the call. blatant: above, or the fact does not exist; goes to the reviewer, then stops the reading if no honest explanation is found. Non-numeric contradictions (a named customer that does not exist, a founder who never worked there) are blatant by default.

web.rule: A claim is confirmed or contradicted on the web only with at least min_independent_sources sources on distinct domains, after searching both for and against. Otherwise it is unverifiable, which is a valid state, never 'probably false'.

customers.proof: customer list with first payment dates

pricing.proof: revenue export showing the price paid

market.proof: public data behind the bottom-up figures

question.en: Gross merchandise value and take rate?
question.fr: Volume d'affaires (GMV) et take rate ?

questions.found_if: Both figures, and the net revenue that follows from them.

question.en: Match rate and time to match?
question.fr: Taux de match et temps de match ?

questions.found_if: Share of requests served, and the delay.

question.en: Concentration?
question.fr: Concentration ?

questions.found_if: Share of volume made by the top 10 sellers or buyers.

question.en: Do both sides come back?
question.fr: Les deux côtés reviennent-ils ?

questions.found_if: Retention figures for supply and demand, separately.

question.en: Who is the paying customer, precisely?
question.fr: Qui est le client qui paie, précisément ?

questions.found_if: A nameable profile, and at least one real customer that matches it.

question.en: Why do they buy, in their own words?
question.fr: Pourquoi il achète, dans ses mots ?

questions.found_if: A customer quote or a documented use case.

question.en: What changed since the start?
question.fr: Qu'est-ce qui a changé depuis le début ?

questions.found_if: A pivot or an invalidated hypothesis, dated.
questions.note: Nothing abandoned in two years = partial at best.

question.en: How many paying customers, since when?
question.fr: Combien de clients payants, depuis quand ?

questions.found_if: A number and a first payment date, backed by an annex or the web.

question.en: Monthly revenue and its curve?
question.fr: Revenus mensuels et courbe ?

questions.found_if: An MRR or equivalent over at least 3 months, with the data points, not only the last one.
questions.note: A growth percentage without the starting point = absent.

question.en: Do customers come back?
question.fr: Est-ce que les clients reviennent ?

questions.found_if: A retention figure: cohorts, churn, recurring usage.
questions.note: A cohort that flattens after week 8 is the signal seed funds look for.

question.en: Do the named customers exist and really use the product?
question.fr: Les clients nommés existent-ils et utilisent-ils vraiment le produit ?

questions.found_if: Confirmed outside the deck: website, LinkedIn, public testimonial, or an annex.
questions.note: The central question of the stage. Cannot be found from the deck alone.

question.en: How many customers lost, and why?
question.fr: Combien de clients perdus, et pourquoi ?

questions.found_if: A figure and a reason.
questions.note: Absent = the deck hides churn. Red.

question.en: Where do customers come from?
question.fr: D'où viennent les clients ?

questions.found_if: A named channel with its share, and the share of organic or word of mouth.

question.en: What price, paid by whom, since when?
question.fr: Quel prix, payé par qui, depuis combien de temps ?

questions.found_if: A price actually collected.
questions.note: A price list without a payment = partial.

question.en: Customer acquisition cost?
question.fr: Coût d'acquisition d'un client ?

questions.found_if: A figure with the method, even on 10 customers.
questions.note: Show the model benchmark with the caveat 'small sample'.

question.en: Gross margin per customer?
question.fr: Marge brute par client ?

questions.found_if: A figure. Estimated without a basis = partial.

question.en: Sales cycle?
question.fr: Cycle de vente ?

questions.found_if: An average duration from first contact to payment.

question.en: Market size computed bottom-up?
question.fr: Taille du marché par le bas ?

questions.found_if: Possible customers multiplied by the observed price, with visible assumptions.

question.en: Who are the competitors, and where are they better?
question.fr: Qui sont les concurrents, et où sont-ils meilleurs ?

questions.found_if: Named, with one point where they win.
questions.note: Web check: omitted competitors become a contradiction.

question.en: Why now?
question.fr: Pourquoi maintenant ?

questions.found_if: A recent, named, verifiable change.

question.en: Who did what before, verifiably?
question.fr: Qui a fait quoi avant, vérifiable ?

questions.found_if: Named achievements, confirmed on LinkedIn or elsewhere.
questions.note: A title without a result = partial.

question.en: Who was hired since, and for what?
question.fr: Qui a été recruté depuis, et pour quoi ?

questions.found_if: Names and roles.
questions.note: Absent = the previous money did not go into the team.

question.en: Full-time, and equity split?
question.fr: Temps plein et répartition des parts ?

questions.found_if: Stated for each founder.

question.en: Who is missing to reach series A?
question.fr: Qui manque pour passer la série A ?

questions.found_if: A named gap with a hiring plan.
questions.note: A named gap is worth more than a hidden gap.

question.en: How much is asked, and what for?
question.fr: Combien demandé, à quoi ça sert ?

questions.found_if: An amount and a breakdown.

question.en: What figures must be reached for series A?
question.fr: Quels chiffres à atteindre pour la série A ?

questions.found_if: A measurable, dated goal: MRR, customers, retention.
questions.note: Absent = the money has no purpose.

question.en: How many months of runway?
question.fr: Combien de mois de runway ?

questions.found_if: A monthly burn and a duration.
questions.note: 12 to 18 months with named milestones is what funds expect.

question.en: Who already invested, and do they follow on?
question.fr: Qui a déjà investi, et remet-il au pot ?

questions.found_if: Names, amounts, and whether existing investors follow on.
questions.note: Existing investors who do not follow on: a question for the call.

question.en: Customers we can call?
question.fr: Des clients qu'on peut appeler ?

questions.found_if: Names and a way to contact them, or the deck says they are available.

question.en: Former colleagues or investors we can call?
question.fr: Des anciens collègues ou investisseurs qu'on peut appeler ?

questions.found_if: Same.
questions.note: Asked to prepare the call, not to judge the deck.
